metadata.abstract: As industry boundaries dissolve and digitalization grows apace, ecosystems are becoming increasingly important. metadata.abstract: Incumbent companies across industries such as banking, insurance, and enterprise software have begun transforming their existing product platform ecosystems into innovation platforms ecosystems to increase generativity in their ecosystems. Such ecosystem t ransformations not only entail technological challenges as the underlying platform technology changes but also organizational challenges in that ecosystem actors such as partners and customers need to become part of the transformed ecosystem.
